description:
Organize a Secret Santa gift exchange — fully offline, no account, no server Open Secret Santa is a simple Secret Santa gift exchange organizer that runs entirely on your device. No backend, no account, no network access — the app doesn't even request the INTERNET permission. All data is encoded in shareable links. Features
  • Create a Secret Santa: add participants, set a random seed, and generate assignments
  • Shareable links: each participant gets a unique link showing only their own assignment
  • Admin view: password-protected link to see all assignments
  • Reproducible: the same participants and seed always produce the same assignments
  • Smart matching: people entered next to each other in the list (couples, families) never draw each other
  • Native sharing: share links through any app, with clipboard integration
  • Deep links: Secret Santa links to secret-santa.bombfork.net open directly in the app
  • 18 languages: including regional and a few fantasy ones
How it works
  1. Enter participant names, a random seed, and an admin password
  2. Send each participant their unique link
  3. Participants open their link to see who they're gifting to
  4. The admin link reveals all assignments with the password
Made for fair players This app works on the honor system. Links are encoded, not encrypted — perfect for friendly groups (family, friends, coworkers) where everyone plays by the rules. If you need Fort Knox security, this might not be your app! 😊
